record.site_name: ASU Polytech Center for Bio-mediated and Bio-inspired Geotechnics (CBBG) Field Lab
record.site_desc: The study site is situated in the CBBG Soils Field Laboratory at the ASU Polytechnic campus in Mesa, Arizona. It is located in an open area near service roads and utility structures. The surrounding environment features a solar park, research facilities, and low-density urban development, including educational buildings and low-rise residential housing. The soil at the site is well-drained but is covered with engineered surfaces.

grp_location.location_comment: Situated in the CBBG Soils Field Laboratory (Polytechnic) at ASU, the site is surrounded by educational and research facilities, with solar park and residential housing located to the north. The area also includes adjacent service roads and utility structures.

grp_igbp.igbp_comment: The vegetation surrounding the tower consists primarily of scattered desert shrubs and bushes, along with some managed or decorative plants near the fence. These plants are drought-tolerant and adapted to the arid climate, featuring small leaves and spaced-out growth.
